name: Realism
intro: From the 1830s to the 1890s, painters in France, Britain, Germany, Russia and the United States turned to ordinary people, real places and the news of their own time. This section follows them through fifty works, with the facts of each object drawn from museum collection records.
homeDescription: Fifty works trace Realism from the Barbizon painters, Courbet, Millet and Daumier to Menzel, Repin, Homer, Eakins and Tanner.
ldDescription: An artwork-by-artwork guide to Realist art, 1830s–1890s, compiled from museum collection records.
sourcesDescription: Lectures, curricula, museum collection records and reference sources used to compile {name}.
